verdict.rationale: Apify's evidence shows a general Actor marketplace, SDKs, CLI, and an MCP server that lets AI agents call existing Actors, but nothing describes an LLM reading a page and dynamically choosing structured fields without pre-built selectors/schemas — the closest hint (apify-docs-10/apify-probe-3) is about agents discovering and invoking Actors as tools, not schema-free AI extraction.
